kernels.name: ft_purged_kfold_indices

kernels.doc: Backtest every column of a row-major (n_bars, n_combos) signal matrix against `close` (same semantics as backtest_core; NaN signals hold the position). kernels.name: ft_sweep_signals

kernels.doc: Whole sweep of a built-in strategy in Rust, signal generation included. `combos` is row-major (n_combos, n_params) in the strategy's canonical parameter order (see ft_sweep_strategy_n_params). Combos violating the strategy's constraints (e.g. fast >= slow, non-integer periods) get out_valid = 0 and NaN returns/metrics; FT_ERR_INVALID_PARAM if none is valid.
kernels.name: ft_sweep_builtin

kernels.doc: Plateau-robust scores: mean of `values` over each combination's grid neighbourhood (combinations within `radius` steps on every axis; NaN ignored). `coords` is row-major (n_combos, n_axes) per-axis grid indices (>= 0).
kernels.name: ft_sweep_plateau_scores

kernels.doc: Write the first `n_settings` entries of the default settings vector for ft_backtest_ohlcv (index with FT_BT_*): market-open fills, no stops, no costs, 100000 initial capital, 252 periods per year. Pass your array's own length (at most ft_backtest_n_settings()), so code built against an older header stays in bounds.
kernels.name: ft_backtest_default_settings

kernels.doc: OHLCV backtest engine: lagged signals fill at the bar open (or close), with stop-loss, take-profit, trailing and breakeven stops, max-hold exits, limit orders, leverage/margin calls, loss circuit breakers, the full commission model, ATR slippage and volume-capped partial fills. `settings` is indexed by FT_BT_* and may be shorter than ft_backtest_n_settings() (missing entries take defaults). `volume` (required when FT_BT_MAX_PARTICIPATION > 0) and `limit_prices` (NaN = market order) may be NULL. Equity starts at 1.0.
kernels.name: ft_backtest_ohlcv

kernels.doc: Performance metrics of a strategy-return / equity series (e.g. from ft_backtest_ohlcv), written as one row indexed by FT_METRIC_*. With `positions` (optional) trades are counted from position changes; otherwise inferred from non-zero return runs. With `benchmark_returns` (optional, per-bar returns) out_benchmark gets the FT_BENCH_* metrics; without it, NaN. n_metric_cols / n_benchmark_cols must equal ft_sweep_n_metrics() / ft_benchmark_n_metrics().
kernels.name: ft_performance_metrics

kernels.doc: SMA crossover signals: +1 when SMA(fast) > SMA(slow), -1 below, NaN during warm-up. Requires fast < slow.
kernels.name: ft_sma_crossover_signals

kernels.doc: MACD crossover signals: +1 when the MACD line is above its signal line, -1 below, NaN during warm-up. Requires fastperiod < slowperiod.
kernels.name: ft_macd_crossover_signals

kernels.doc: Close-only vectorised backtest: positions are lagged signals (NaN holds the prior position), slippage and commission are charged on position changes. Uses FT_BT_SLIPPAGE_BPS, FT_BT_INITIAL_CAPITAL and the commission entries of `settings` (same vector as ft_backtest_ohlcv); other entries must still be valid but have no effect (short-borrow costs are not modelled by this engine).
kernels.name: ft_backtest_close

kernels.doc: Block-bootstrap Monte Carlo of strategy returns: n_sims resampled equity curves, row-major (n_sims, n_bars). block_size 0 or 1 = i.i.d. resampling. Deterministic for a given seed; any 64-bit seed (reinterpreted as unsigned) reproduces the Python/WASM paths.
kernels.name: ft_monte_carlo_bootstrap

kernels.doc: Walk-forward fold boundaries, row-major (n_folds, 4) rows of [train_start, train_end, test_start, test_end]. anchored: 0 = rolling window, 1 = expanding from bar 0. step_bars 0 = non-overlapping test windows.
kernels.name: ft_walk_forward_indices

kernels.doc: Round-trip trades from an OHLCV backtest (positions and fill prices from ft_backtest_ohlcv). Writes out_n_trades rows into columns of capacity n_bars; rows past it hold -1 (bar indices) or NaN. mae/mfe are the maximum adverse/favourable excursions as fractions of the entry price.
kernels.name: ft_extract_trades

kernels.doc: Multi-asset backtest: each asset's close-only backtest on its weight column, combined into a portfolio. close and weights are row-major (n_bars, n_assets). Exposure caps (0 = off for gross/net, 1 = off for per-asset) are applied to the weights bar by bar.
kernels.name: ft_backtest_multi_asset

streams.doc: Streaming MACD with fixed 12/26 EMAs: (macd, signal, hist), NaN until the signal is valid.
streams.name: macdfix

streams.doc: Streaming MACD with a moving-average type per leg: (macd, signal, hist), NaN until the signal is valid.
streams.name: macdext

streams.doc: Streaming absolute price oscillator: fast MA - slow MA (both of type `matype`).
streams.name: apo

streams.doc: Streaming percentage price oscillator: (ppo, signal, hist); the signal is an EMA of the PPO line.
streams.name: ppo

streams.doc: Streaming TRIX: one-bar percent rate of change of a triple EMA.
streams.name: trix

streams.doc: Streaming Williams %R: -100 * (highest high - close) / (highest high - lowest low) over `timeperiod` bars.
streams.name: willr

streams.doc: Streaming Commodity Channel Index over `timeperiod` bars.
streams.name: cci

streams.doc: Streaming Balance of Power: (close - open) / (high - low).
streams.name: bop

streams.doc: Streaming momentum: close - close[timeperiod bars ago].
streams.name: mom

streams.doc: Streaming rate of change: (close - prev) / prev * 100 (NaN where prev is 0).
streams.name: roc

streams.doc: Streaming rate of change percentage: (close - prev) / prev (NaN where prev is 0).
streams.name: rocp

streams.doc: Streaming rate of change ratio: close / prev (NaN where prev is 0).
streams.name: rocr

streams.doc: Streaming rate of change ratio x 100: close / prev * 100 (NaN where prev is 0).
streams.name: rocr100

streams.doc: Streaming Aroon: (aroon_down, aroon_up) over a `timeperiod + 1` bar window; ties go to the most recent bar.
streams.name: aroon

streams.doc: Streaming Aroon oscillator: aroon_up - aroon_down.
streams.name: aroonosc

streams.doc: Streaming Ultimate Oscillator: buying pressure over three periods weighted 4 / 2 / 1.
streams.name: ultosc

streams.doc: Streaming Chande momentum oscillator (Wilder smoothed gains and losses).
streams.name: cmo

streams.doc: Streaming fast stochastic: (fastk, fastd); both NaN until %D is valid.
streams.name: stochf

streams.doc: Streaming stochastic RSI: (fastk, fastd); both NaN until %D is valid.
streams.name: stochrsi

streams.doc: Streaming +DM, Wilder smoothed; first value at bar `timeperiod - 1` (raw +DM when `timeperiod` is 1).
streams.name: plus_dm

streams.doc: Streaming -DM, Wilder smoothed; first value at bar `timeperiod - 1` (raw -DM when `timeperiod` is 1).
streams.name: minus_dm

streams.doc: Streaming +DI = 100 * smoothed +DM / smoothed TR; first value at bar `timeperiod`.
streams.name: plus_di

streams.doc: Streaming -DI = 100 * smoothed -DM / smoothed TR; first value at bar `timeperiod`.
streams.name: minus_di

streams.doc: Streaming directional movement index: 100 * abs(+DI - -DI) / (+DI + -DI); first value at bar `timeperiod`.
streams.name: dx

streams.doc: Streaming average directional index; first value at bar `2 * timeperiod - 1`.
streams.name: adx

streams.doc: Streaming ADX rating: (ADX + ADX `timeperiod - 1` bars ago) / 2.
streams.name: adxr

streams.doc: Streaming money flow index over `timeperiod` bars of typical-price money flow. Mirrors the batch running flow sums (not a fresh window sum), so an all-zero-volume window leaves the same residue as the batch function.
streams.name: mfi

streams.doc: Streaming true range (NaN on the first bar: no previous close).
streams.name: trange

streams.doc: Streaming normalized ATR: Wilder ATR / close * 100 (NaN where close is 0).
streams.name: natr

streams.doc: Streaming on-balance volume; the first bar is the first volume.
streams.name: obv

streams.doc: Streaming Chaikin accumulation / distribution line.
streams.name: ad

streams.doc: Streaming Chaikin A/D oscillator: fast EMA - slow EMA of the A/D line, both seeded from its first value.
streams.name: adosc

streams.doc: Streaming Hanging Man candlestick pattern: -100 (bearish) when matched, else 0.

streams.doc: Streaming rolling population standard deviation over `timeperiod` bars, scaled by `nbdev`. Recomputes each window exactly; on long series the batch function accumulates rounding drift, so values can differ beyond 1e-9 (the stream is the exact one).
streams.name: stddev

streams.doc: Streaming rolling population variance over `timeperiod` bars, scaled by `nbdev**2`. Recomputes each window exactly; on long series the batch function accumulates rounding drift, so values can differ beyond 1e-9 (the stream is the exact one).
streams.name: var

streams.doc: Streaming linear regression fitted value at the last bar of the window.
streams.name: linearreg

streams.doc: Streaming slope of the rolling linear regression line. Recomputes each window exactly; on long series the batch function accumulates rounding drift, so values can differ beyond 1e-9 (the stream is the exact one).
streams.name: linearreg_slope

streams.doc: Streaming intercept of the rolling linear regression line.
streams.name: linearreg_intercept

streams.doc: Streaming angle of the rolling regression line in degrees. Recomputes each window exactly; on long series the batch function accumulates rounding drift, so values can differ beyond 1e-9 (the stream is the exact one).
streams.name: linearreg_angle

streams.doc: Streaming time series forecast: the regression line extrapolated one bar ahead.
streams.name: tsf

streams.doc: Streaming rolling beta of `real1` returns on `real0` returns over `timeperiod` returns.
streams.name: beta

streams.doc: Streaming rolling Pearson correlation of two series over `timeperiod` bars. Recomputes each window exactly; on long series the batch function accumulates rounding drift, so values can differ beyond 1e-9 (the stream is the exact one).
streams.name: correl

streams.doc: Streaming IV rank: position of the latest IV between the window's min and max.
streams.name: iv_rank

streams.doc: Streaming IV percentile: share of window values at or below the latest IV.
streams.name: iv_percentile

streams.doc: Streaming IV z-score of the latest IV against the window mean and deviation.
streams.name: iv_zscore

streams.doc: Streaming annualised close-to-close realized volatility (first value after `window` returns).
streams.name: close_to_close_vol

streams.doc: Streaming annualised Parkinson high-low realized volatility.
streams.name: parkinson_vol

streams.doc: Streaming annualised Garman-Klass OHLC realized volatility.
streams.name: garman_klass_vol

streams.doc: Streaming annualised Rogers-Satchell OHLC realized volatility.
streams.name: rogers_satchell_vol

streams.doc: Streaming annualised Yang-Zhang OHLC realized volatility (first value after `window` bars plus the prior close).
streams.name: yang_zhang_vol

streams.doc: Streaming trend (1) / range (0) label from ADX against `threshold` (-1 where ADX is NaN).
streams.name: regime_adx

streams.doc: Streaming trend (1) / range (0) label: ADX above `adx_threshold` and ATR / close above `atr_pct_threshold`.
streams.name: regime_combined

streams.doc: Streaming CUSUM structural-break flag (1 at a break bar) against the previous `window` bars.
streams.name: detect_breaks_cusum

streams.doc: Streaming volatility-regime break flag: short / long window variance ratio above `threshold` (current bar excluded).
streams.name: rolling_variance_break

streams.doc: Streaming rolling beta of `asset` against `benchmark` over `window` bars.
streams.name: rolling_beta

streams.doc: Streaming relative strength: cumulative product of (1 + asset return) over that of the benchmark.
streams.name: relative_strength

streams.doc: Streaming spread a - hedge * b.
streams.name: spread

streams.doc: Streaming ratio a / b (NaN where b is 0).
streams.name: ratio

streams.doc: Streaming rolling z-score of `x` over `window` bars.
streams.name: zscore_series

streams.doc: Streaming weighted contract stitching: front * (1 - w) + next * w.
streams.name: weighted_continuous

streams.doc: Streaming cross event between `fast` and `slow`: 1 cross-over, -1 cross-under, 0 none.
streams.name: check_cross

streams.doc: Streaming cumulative funding PnL: running sum of -position_size * funding_rate.
streams.name: funding_cumulative_pnl

streams.doc: Streaming RSI threshold signal: +1 at or below `oversold`, -1 at or above `overbought`, else 0 (NaN during warm-up).
streams.name: rsi_threshold_signals

streams.doc: Streaming Donchian channels: (upper, middle, lower) = rolling highest high, midpoint, lowest low over `timeperiod` bars.
streams.name: donchian

streams.doc: Streaming Choppiness Index over `timeperiod` bars (first value at bar `timeperiod`).
streams.name: choppiness_index

streams.doc: Streaming Bollinger %B: (close - lower) / (upper - lower) of SMA bands (NaN on a zero-width band). Recomputes each window exactly; on long series the batch function accumulates rounding drift, so values can differ beyond 1e-9 (the stream is the exact one).
streams.name: bbpercent

streams.doc: Streaming Bollinger bandwidth: (upper - lower) / middle of SMA bands (NaN on a zero middle).
streams.name: bbwidth

streams.doc: Streaming close-to-close historical volatility: population stddev of `timeperiod` log returns, annualised, in percent.
streams.name: historical_volatility

streams.doc: Streaming Ulcer Index: RMS over `timeperiod` bars of the percent drawdown from the rolling `timeperiod`-bar high (the batch running sum is mirrored, so a rounding-negative mean square is NaN as in the batch function).
streams.name: ulcer_index

streams.doc: Streaming rolling median over `timeperiod` bars (even windows average the two central values).
streams.name: median

streams.doc: Streaming rolling mode: centre of the most populous of `bins` equal-width bins over `timeperiod` bars.
streams.name: mode

streams.doc: Streaming Keltner channels: (upper, middle, lower) = EMA(close) +/- `multiplier` * ATR(`atr_period`); the middle EMA is emitted on its own once seeded.
streams.name: keltner_channels

streams.doc: Streaming Chandelier exit: (highest high - `multiplier` * ATR, lowest low + `multiplier` * ATR) over `timeperiod` bars.
streams.name: chandelier_exit

streams.doc: Streaming STARC bands: (upper, middle, lower) = SMA(close) +/- `multiplier` * ATR(`atr_period`); the middle SMA is emitted on its own once full.
streams.name: starc

streams.doc: Streaming median bands: (median, upper, lower, median EMA) from the rolling median of (high + low) / 2, ATR envelopes and an EMA of the median.
streams.name: median_bands

streams.doc: Streaming Chande Kroll stop: rolling `stop_period` extremes of the ATR-offset `timeperiod` highest high / lowest low.
streams.name: chande_kroll_stop

streams.doc: Streaming moving-average envelopes: (upper, middle, lower) = MA * (1 +/- `percent` / 100), MA of type `matype`.
streams.name: ma_envelopes

streams.doc: Streaming Chaikin volatility: `rocperiod`-bar percent rate of change of an EMA of the high-low range.
streams.name: chaikin_vol

streams.doc: Streaming Mass index: `sumperiod`-bar sum of EMA(range) / EMA(EMA(range)); the sum restarts after a non-finite ratio.
streams.name: mass

streams.doc: Streaming Random Walk Index: (high, low) maxima over lookbacks 2..=`timeperiod` of the range move per ATR * sqrt(lookback).
streams.name: rwi

streams.doc: Streaming Awesome Oscillator: SMA(median price, fast) - SMA(median price, slow). Recomputes each window exactly; on long series the batch function accumulates rounding drift, so values can differ beyond 1e-9 (the stream is the exact one).
streams.name: ao

streams.doc: Streaming Accelerator Oscillator: AO - SMA(AO, `timeperiod`).
streams.name: ac

streams.doc: Streaming price oscillator: SMA(close, fast) - SMA(close, slow). Recomputes each window exactly; on long series the batch function accumulates rounding drift, so values can differ beyond 1e-9 (the stream is the exact one).
streams.name: po

streams.doc: Streaming detrended price oscillator: close `timeperiod / 2 + 1` bars ago minus SMA(close, `timeperiod`). Recomputes each window exactly; on long series the batch function accumulates rounding drift, so values can differ beyond 1e-9 (the stream is the exact one).
streams.name: dpo

streams.doc: Streaming Relative Vigor Index and its 4-bar weighted signal (the batch running window sums are mirrored, so a flat window's zero denominator matches the batch function).
streams.name: rvi

streams.doc: Streaming Know Sure Thing: weighted sum of four SMA-smoothed ROCs, plus an SMA signal.
streams.name: kst

streams.doc: Streaming Vortex indicator: (+VI, -VI) over `timeperiod` bars; a non-finite true range counts as 0.
streams.name: vortex

streams.doc: Streaming Coppock curve: WMA(ROC(`roc1`) + ROC(`roc2`), `wma_period`).
streams.name: coppock

streams.doc: Streaming directional movement index: (+DI, -DI, ADX) from one Wilder state.
streams.name: dmi

streams.doc: Streaming Elder Ray: (bull, bear) = (high - EMA(close), low - EMA(close)).
streams.name: elder_ray

streams.doc: Streaming Ehlers Fisher transform of the median price over `timeperiod` bars, plus the previous value as signal.
streams.name: fisher

streams.doc: Streaming Connors RSI: mean of RSI(close), RSI(up/down streak) and the percent rank of the 1-bar ROC.
streams.name: crsi

streams.doc: Streaming True Strength Index: 100 * double-EMA(momentum) / double-EMA(abs(momentum)), plus an EMA signal.
streams.name: tsi

streams.doc: Streaming Schaff Trend Cycle: stochastic of the EMA MACD, EMA-smoothed, stochastic again, EMA-smoothed, clamped to [0, 100].
streams.name: stc

streams.doc: Streaming Hull moving average: WMA(2 * WMA(n/2) - WMA(n), sqrt(n)).
streams.name: hull_ma

streams.doc: Streaming Arnaud Legoux moving average: Gaussian-weighted mean of the last `timeperiod` closes.
streams.name: alma

streams.doc: Streaming Bill Williams Alligator: (jaw, teeth, lips) SMMAs of the median price, each shifted forward by its shift.
streams.name: alligator

streams.doc: Streaming Gator oscillator: (abs(jaw - teeth), -abs(teeth - lips)) of the Alligator lines.
streams.name: gator

streams.doc: Streaming zero-lag EMA: EMA of close + (close - close `(timeperiod - 1) / 2` bars ago), seeded on the first full finite window.
streams.name: zlema

streams.doc: Streaming Ehlers fractal adaptive moving average, seeded with the close at bar `timeperiod - 1`.
streams.name: frama

streams.doc: Streaming McGinley dynamic, seeded with the SMA of the first `timeperiod` closes.
streams.name: mcginley

streams.doc: Streaming Chande VIDYA: an EMA whose factor is scaled by abs(CMO(`cmo_period`)) / 100, seeded with the close on the first CMO bar.
streams.name: vidya

streams.doc: Streaming Chaikin money flow: `timeperiod`-bar sum of CLV * volume over the volume sum. Mirrors the batch running volume sums (not a fresh window sum), so an all-zero-volume window leaves the same residue and NaN mask as the batch function.
streams.name: cmf

streams.doc: Streaming ease of movement: SMA over `timeperiod` bars of midpoint move * range * `scale` / volume (raw when `timeperiod` is 1).
streams.name: emv

streams.doc: Streaming volume oscillator: 100 * (SMA(volume, fast) - SMA(volume, slow)) / SMA(volume, slow). Mirrors the batch running volume sums (not a fresh window sum), so an all-zero-volume window leaves the same residue and NaN mask as the batch function.
streams.name: volosc

streams.doc: Streaming volume rate of change over `timeperiod` bars, in percent.
streams.name: vroc

streams.doc: Streaming relative volume: volume / SMA(volume, `timeperiod`). Mirrors the batch running volume sums (not a fresh window sum), so an all-zero-volume window leaves the same residue and NaN mask as the batch function.
streams.name: rvol

streams.doc: Streaming volume-weighted moving average over `timeperiod` bars.
streams.name: vwma

streams.doc: Streaming Chaikin oscillator: fast EMA - slow EMA of the A/D line, both seeded from its first value (same as ADOSC).
streams.name: cho

streams.doc: Streaming on-balance volume smoothed by a moving average of type `matype`.
streams.name: obv_smoothed

streams.doc: Streaming force index: EMA of (close - previous close) * volume (raw when `timeperiod` is 1).
streams.name: force_index

streams.doc: Streaming negative volume index from 1000: moves with the close only on bars whose volume falls.
streams.name: nvi

streams.doc: Streaming positive volume index from 1000: moves with the close only on bars whose volume rises.
streams.name: pvi

streams.doc: Streaming negative volume index and an EMA signal of it.
streams.name: nvi_with_ema

streams.doc: Streaming positive volume index and a moving-average signal of type `matype`.
streams.name: pvi_with_signal

streams.doc: Streaming Klinger volume oscillator: EMA(volume force, fast) - EMA(volume force, slow), plus an EMA signal.
streams.name: kvo

streams.doc: Streaming price volume trend: cumulative volume * (close - previous close) / previous close, from 0.
streams.name: pvt
